note: Paths under benchmarks/results/ are run write targets; that directory is not tracked, so any predecessor artifact named here is unpublished history recorded for provenance, not a file in this repository.
purpose: Measure the already-frozen support-ticket baseline versus LabeledFewShot design on the one exact-free route selected by an independent synthetic typed-format canary. This preregistration is based only on schema completion and guarded route operation, not benchmark scores, and does not authorize launch.

selection_basis: one strict one-field JSON-schema response completed with the expected typed value
finish_reason was stop at 12 of 128 output tokens
no native reasoning content or reasoning tokens were observed
the requested and actual exact-free model matched through OpenRouter to Darkbloom
one logical request equaled one transport attempt and both cost views were explicitly zero
exclusions: the synthetic canary contains no support-ticket input or label
one successful call does not establish route reliability
format completion does not predict benchmark accuracy or optimizer lift
the public model catalog and eligible privacy route must be revalidated before any separately authorized launch

frozen_design.schedule: For each seed in order, run baseline then labeled_few_shot; stop immediately on any strict failure.

execution.output_envelope_rationale: The selected route completed the independent strict one-field schema canary in 12 output tokens with no observed reasoning tokens. A 128-token ceiling leaves more than a tenfold margin for the same response shape while remaining fail-closed; it was selected before any V3 support-ticket response or score existed.

required_prelaunch_validation: an owner or principal explicitly authorizes V3 after reviewing this preregistration
the exact :free model remains present with zero prompt and completion catalog prices
the catalog still advertises response_format and structured_outputs for the exact model
the strict support-ticket response schema is present in the locally serialized request
max_price=0, no fallback, require_parameters, data_collection=deny, usage include, and one transport attempt are locally validated
the repository is clean and all broad gates pass without claim or source drift
required_response_evidence: request schema and exact requested model
typed content digest and bounded safe excerpt
native reasoning presence, digest, bounded safe excerpt, and reasoning-details digest
input, output, and reasoning token counts
gateway, upstream provider, and actual model
provider-reported and computed per-response and cumulative cost
stop_rules: malformed typed response or decoder failure

decision_rules.execution_complete: All 48 predeclared responses and all six arm/seed cells complete without a stop-rule violation.
decision_rules.within_task_go: Mean held-out lift is at least 0.03, the exact paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound is above zero, and at least two of three seeds improve.
decision_rules.incomplete: Any missing arm/seed cell or stop-rule violation. An incomplete run is neither an optimizer win nor an optimizer loss.

claim_limits: This preregistration does not authorize or launch V3.
This single synthetic support-ticket task and single free model cannot establish general LabeledFewShot effectiveness.
There is no independently executed upstream comparator.
This is not the canonical GSM8K and Banking77 optimizer-lift portfolio.
The eight-row test has low statistical resolution.
No result from this campaign may promote a C3 claim or a BEAM-native superiority claim.
